intro: Fifty-seven years of Miami-Dade plumbing does not photograph well — most of our best work ends up buried two feet under somebody's yard or sealed back inside a wall. Below is the kind of work a typical week brings. We are building out a full job-photo library now; in the meantime the reviews on this site are from real customers describing real jobs, and we are happy to give references for work like yours.

projects.title: Main drain line located, dug and cleaned out
projects.alt: Sewer access chamber opened at ground level
projects.description: Two technicians located the blockage the morning after the call. The next morning another pair dug down two feet to the drain line, added a clean-out T and were finished by noon — described by the customer as "cleaned up and left everything perfect."

projects.title: Septic tank and drainfield service
projects.alt: Septic tank access lids opened for inspection in a yard
projects.description: Inspection, pump-out and drainfield assessment on a property still off city sewer. Excavation handled by our own crew and equipment — no sub-contractor between the dig and the repair.

projects.title: Backflow preventer tested and certified
projects.alt: Backflow preventer valve assembly at ground level
projects.description: Annual County-ordinance testing through Backflow Bob, Inc. Most tests take 15 to 20 minutes, with simple repairs handled the same visit.

projects.title: Emergency leak repair
projects.alt: Water spraying from a split pipe joint
projects.description: After-hours call, repaired on the first visit with material carried on the truck. We have had plumbers on call 24 hours a day since 1968.

projects.title: Our shop at 3029 SW 28th Street
projects.alt: The Bay Plumbing Co. building and signage in Miami
projects.description: Same family, same address since 1968 — centrally located to the customers we serve, with the inventory and the equipment fleet kept on site.
